title: ornithogalum narbonense subsp. brevistylum
intro: Ornithogalum narbonense subsp. brevistylum, commonly known as the autumn-flowering ornithogalum or star of Persia, is a plant species in the Asparagaceae family. This plant is known for its ornamental value, with white, star-shaped flowers blooming in the fall. The health benefits of Ornithogalum narbonense subsp. brevistylum include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, which have been shown to possess therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
